The exact persisted real-owner binding count remains a separate S1-18 evidence item.

Admin grants no supervision override. /me demonstrates the handler policy call; later slices implement relationship storage.

Backend #28 subsequently released in 11d38ada-a392-471f-bf45-81592cedf9a5; real Google owner profile acceptance also passes.

S1-16.notes: Released in successful enabled-dev activation 248fa024-49a0-4ebc-bc76-73a236ca9aaa. Exact Cognito CSP and no-store public issuer/client/callback/logout settings are verified, with no credential fields. Release header/browser checks and native dev browser flows pass. S1-10.notes: Frontend #21 is merged and deployed. Actual Google admin sign-in, hosted logout to the signed-out landing, repeat sign-in and page-reload reauthentication were observed on dev after backend #28. Memory-only tokens, state/nonce/PKCE, callback cleanup, refresh/revocation and error handling have automated coverage. Native runner refresh-token revocation is verified separately; no real owner credential was recorded.

S1-11.notes: Deployed landing, admin profile, account menu and signed-out view were verified with the real owner Google account. Native denial and accessibility cases pass. Navigation for future role-specific feature pages remains pending with those features.

S1-12.notes: Backend #25 provides PostgreSQL tests that reuse identical trusted claims after role removal and deactivation and reject token-group elevation. The branch is refreshed with merged backend #28. Real Gateway/native profile acceptance and actual Google admin sign-in are verified. Tests cover database role changes locally; no live owner demotion/deactivation was performed. Review/merge remains pending.

S1-20.notes: Backend #26 and infra #38 are merged. PostgreSQL recovery tests preserve the first bound admin/history, are idempotent and require explicit prod opt-in. The runbook gives exact additional-admin invocation and safe failure handling. Owner explicitly elected to retain the sole dev admin; no second live identity or live recovery drill is claimed.

S1-13.notes: Frontend #22 prepares release native-browser automation. Both native cases passed against deployed dev: real Gateway invited 200 and uninvited 403 relayed unchanged to the UI, revocation, safe storage and no token-group elevation. Actual owner Google first sign-in was reported successful; repeat sign-in, hosted logout and reload were observed and recorded locally after backend #28. Release automation awaits merge; real uninvited/deactivated Google demo remains outstanding.

Read-only Cognito verification finds exactly one enabled federated Google identity with verified email after repeat sign-ins.
